city_access: The city applies where eligible or enables a state, consortium or civil-society partner to apply. Includes national, regional and state programmes.
further_considerations: Potentially relevant until actor, geography, sector, adaptation eligibility and call conditions are checked.
example_datasets: BNDES non-automatic financing operations; FNMA transfer instruments; FNMC non-reimbursable projects

city_access: The city or relevant service provider seeks reimbursable finance from BNDES, CAIXA/FGTS, a regional fund, state bank or another operator.
further_considerations: Conditional on the preliminary credit screen and on product, borrower, project and lender requirements.
example_datasets: BNDES non-automatic financing operations; SADIPEM credit-operation requests

finance_route: Federal transfers and public investment programmes
city_access: The city formulates and submits a project through the applicable programme, including Transferegov arrangements or a Novo PAC selection.
further_considerations: Potentially relevant; programme fit and proposal readiness must be checked. Preparation support may be highlighted.
example_datasets: Novo PAC drainage and slope-containment selections; Transferegov discretionary and legal transfers

city_access: A municipality proposes a larger operation through COFIEX and seeks a loan from an MDB, normally with federal authorisation and a Union guarantee.
further_considerations: Conditional on the preliminary credit screen, COFIEX process, guarantee requirements and lender appraisal.
example_datasets: COFIEX external-financing meeting results; IDB Brazil adaptation projects; SADIPEM credit-operation requests; World Bank Brazil adaptation candidate projects

city_access: The city develops a concept with Brazil's National Designated Authority and an accredited entity such as BNDES, FUNBIO or CAIXA; the city does not apply directly to the facility.
further_considerations: Intermediation requires a partner route and the concept-development questions to verify.
example_datasets: IDB Brazil adaptation projects; World Bank Brazil adaptation candidate projects

city_access: The city follows the MIDR/Sedec and S2ID process for prevention, response or reconstruction, as applicable.
further_considerations: Conditional on the legal trigger, action type, documentation and civil-defence process; hazard exposure alone does not make the route available.
example_datasets: CGU civil-defence transfer payments; Transferegov discretionary and legal transfers
